name: Checkly MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server for Checkly. Lets MCP clients inspect checks and test sessions, trigger existing checks, read root cause analysis, and manage status page incidents.
when_to_use: Use the Checkly MCP server to answer questions about whether a deployed service is currently healthy, to read why a synthetic or uptime check failed, to re-run a check on demand, to pull AI root cause analysis for a failure, and to open or update an incident on a Checkly status page.
